content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the 30-day horizon, especially for the first 5–10 days.
- Model overestimates prices after sharp spikes (e.g., 79.80–80.50 range) and fails to correct downward quickly.
- Model shows persistent lag in capturing true price declines, especially when prices drop below 70.
- Mean reversion is not adequately modeled — model holds onto high forecasts longer than observed price behavior.
- Model tends to overreact to recent high prices, producing inflated forecasts that don’t align with true mean reversion.
- Model underestimates the magnitude of price drops in the final 5–10 days of the forecast horizon.
- Model exhibits bias toward higher prices in the middle of the forecast window, especially when historical prices are trending upward.
